Solar-Powered Surveillance

Visibility that doesn't depend on the grid.

A solar surveillance system combines solar panels, battery storage, cameras and connectivity into one independent installation. The panels charge the batteries during the day and the batteries power the system through the night.

That makes solar-powered camera systems practical where running electricity would be difficult, costly or simply not possible. How a system performs depends on the site, available sunlight, battery capacity and system design, which is why we size each system for its application.

Well suited to

  • Farms and agricultural properties
  • Construction sites
  • Remote properties
  • Equipment yards
  • Temporary sites
  • Areas where running mains electricity is difficult
Built Around Your Site

About Solvex Secure

A South African supplier of practical solar and surveillance equipment.

Solvex Secure is technically minded and solutions-focused. We're here to supply practical equipment for sites that need power or visibility — or both — in places where conventional infrastructure doesn't reach or isn't practical.

We work from the requirements of the site and the customer, and we'd rather understand what you need first than supply something that doesn't fit. Solar-powered surveillance is one of the areas we currently focus on, within a broader range of solar and off-grid equipment.
